message.content:
Based on my search, **Miraculous Ladybug Season 2 Episode 12 has already been released**. 

The episode is titled **"Gorizilla"** (production code 210) and it originally aired on **March 14, 2018** in Canada on Family Channel.

However, I should note that there is some discrepancy in the numbering depending on how episodes are counted:
- If you count the Christmas special "Santa Claws" as Episode 1, then "Gorizilla" is Episode 12
- If you're looking at the production order, Episode 12 is "Gorizilla" (prod. code 210)

There was also a blog post mentioning "Captain Hardrock" as "Episode 12" with a March 30, 2018 release date, but this appears to be using a different numbering system. "Captain Hardrock" (prod. code 216) is officially Episode 13 in most listings.

All of Season 2 has been completed and aired - it ran from December 2016 to November 2018 with 26 episodes total.
